criteria: Channels and counts match settled/shipped orders in the half-open ordered_at period
as_of filters only refund events, inclusively
Integer counts and minor-unit amounts under all five public parameter scenarios
allowed_equivalence: Any safe standard SQLite SELECT/CTE implementation meeting the explicit resource limits

criteria: Every distinct order/line/refund ID contributes exactly once
No join fan-out or deduplication by amount
allowed_equivalence: Preaggregation, correlated subqueries, filtered scalar sums and other equivalent algorithms

criteria: Complete zero-child orders counted as known zero
Partial or missing child capture yields unknown gross/net while retaining known subtotal
Mandatory separate unmatched-order refund row; out-of-cohort existing orders excluded
Unallocated net remains NULL; negative known net allowed
Read-only saved SQL runs under restricted SQLite worker
Exact ordered columns and per-channel values match independent direct record calculation for all five visible parameter scenarios
allowed_equivalence: SQL source text/structure/aliases inside the query may vary; final required column names remain exact

criteria: Saved CSV contains exact main-scenario values and canonical integer/NULL representations
Saved CSV agrees with executed saved SQL
Required notes declarations appear once with exact main parameters and metric meanings
allowed_equivalence: Optional additional truthful plain-language explanations require source-grounded review if consequential claims appear

integrity.basis: All original runner files, including task and input manifest, bound by evaluator-owned hashes; common safe regular-file contract
checks: No symlink in any path component; bounded regular-file reads
Hash every original runner file against the independent evaluator-owned runner_files manifest
integrity.note: These local file checks do not establish absence of external actions. The parent harness must independently review execution trace/policy integrity, including any claimed actions, before final trial acceptance.

acceptance: All five binary groups and source integrity true; full trial acceptance additionally requires harness process-integrity gate. Unknown evidence is not imputed as a pass.
blinding: Do not stage any evaluator, rubric, expected output, reference, control or result file into runner workspaces.
infrastructure_gate: Trusted worker launch/setup failures produce pending/null, never behavioral failure; query contract/resource violations are ordinary task failures
